analytic_target.statement: Show every major-arc obstruction to the X^(31/25) primitive Poisson bound supplies a seeded deep packet, then control or exploit its realized AP rows.

claim_boundary: This artifact proves seed propagation along one approximate rational packet. It does not count seeds or packets and proves no large-value, powered, density, or interval gain.

exact_replay.critical_interface: K>=X^(6/25) gives realized AP degree X^(6/25-o(1)); maximal depth then requires q<=X^(1/5+o(1))
exact_replay.gate: bound seeded deep packets or feed their realized AP rows to E7/E9/E10 with the enlarged constant tracked
exact_replay.realized_hit_count: at least 1+floor(K/2) at strip constant C0+C1
exact_replay.scope_correction: without one genuine transport seed, a beta-free packet supplies allowable differences only

prior_context.prior_role: make the deep-packet structured branch a realized rather than beta-free recurrence statement

scope_correction.statement: Without a genuine beta-dependent seed, a beta-free packet supplies allowable differences only and is not yet an E7/E9/E10 recurrence handoff.

seeded_recurrence.statement: One genuine strip hit plus packet depth K yields at least 1+floor(K/2) realized q-progression hits at enlarged constant C0+C1.
